title: Telling the Time
description: Hours, quarters, halves and times of day.

items.exampleEn: Excuse me, what time is it?

items.exampleFr: Il est une heure, on mange ?
items.exampleEn: It is one o'clock, shall we eat?

items.explain: Il est deux heures de l'après-midi. — It is two in the afternoon.
Il est trois heures et quart. — It is quarter past three.

items.exampleFr: Il est six heures et demie.

items.explain: Il est neuf heures moins le quart. — It is quarter to nine.
Il est huit heures moins dix. — It is ten to eight.

items.exampleEn: It is noon, I am hungry.

items.explain: Il est minuit, bonne nuit ! — It is midnight, good night!

items.translation: in the morning / in the afternoon / in the evening
